entry.title: OpenAI Dev Day 2025: ChatGPT becomes the new app store — and hardware is coming
entry.summary: In a packed hall at Fort Mason Center in San Francisco, against a backdrop of the Golden Gate Bridge, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out a bold vision to remake the digital world.
